take: Per the team's announcement, Vancouver recalled F Jacob Quillan from Abbotsford (AHL) and placed F Filip Chytil on injured reserve. Chytil has two assists in seven games and has been on the ice for 29% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances), and VAN's share improves by 12 points when he sits. With VAN at 3-11-1, Elias Pettersson (20:35 a night) is next in line for Chytil's first-line minutes, going by how the coach has used his players. We have no numbers on Quillan.
